event.event_name.snippet: 6. Narrow Halpha and He I. Nice 20 day rise, discovery 3.5 days after GW170313. No clear epoch based on SNID, based on light curve rising or near peak. At z=0.015 the most recent

notes: 19 ATLAS/PS1 transients in the G277583 skymap, spectroscopically classified with UH88/SNIFS. Discovery photometry captured (filter c/o=ATLAS cyan/orange, i/w=PS1, all AB; row19 V ~19.5 approximate).

SCHEMA GAP: per-source classification and redshift (types Ia/Ib/Ic/II/IIn/Ia-91T; z 0.013-0.09) cannot be stored - classification and redshift are singular. Type/z/TNS-name per source are in the source table. 4 objects pre-date the GW trigger (noted 'for completeness').
